{07 15 00}It's not how a guy looks{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 0f 00}
It's what's inside that
counts, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
{07 16 00}Yeah. At least,{01 00 00 03 00} that's what
people tell me all the
time{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.
{07 0e 00}Hmmm, were they saying I
looked nerdy?{01 00 00 0f 00} Anyway, you 
can't neglect your looks.
{07 00 00}If you ask me,{01 00 00 03 00} it's all
about choosing the right
style for the situation.
{07 15 00}So truly great outfits only
happen for people with big
wardrobes, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
{07 19 00}That's my policy right now,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.{01 00 00 0f 00} {07 0d 00}Buying lots
and lots of clothes!
messages.et:
{07 15 00}Pole tähtis, kuidas tüüp
välja näeb{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 0f 00}
Tähtis on sisu, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
{07 16 00}Jah. Vähemalt{01 00 00 03 00} nii mulle
kogu aeg
öeldakse{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.
{07 0e 00}Hmmm, kas nad ütlesid, et
näen nohiklik?{01 00 00 0f 00} Igatahes,
välimust ei tohi unustada.
{07 00 00}Minu arust{01 00 00 03 00} on kõik selles,
et valida olukorrale
õige stiil.
{07 15 00}Nii et head rõivad
saavad olla vaid neil, kel
on suur kapp, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
{07 19 00}See on praegu mu poliitika,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.{01 00 00 0f 00} {07 0d 00}Osta palju
ja palju riideid!

messages.en:
{07 00 00}I might not look like it, 
but I'm a {04 03 00} boy
through and through.
{07 14 00}Can you believe I'm actually
into stylish clothes,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}?
So hey, {04 1f 00}, if you
see something I might like,
let me know, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
messages.et:
{07 00 00}Ma ei näe ehk välja nii,
aga ma olen {04 03 00} poiss
läbi ja lõhki.
{07 14 00}Kas sa usud, et ma olen
tegelikult stiilsete riiete
lainel, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}?
Nii et, {04 1f 00}, kui sa
näed midagi, mis võiks
meeldida, ütle, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!

messages.en:
{07 00 00}Maybe I should do something
about my out-of-control 
clothes-shopping habit.
{07 16 00}Because{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.I'm totally broke,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!

{07 04 00}Do you have any clothes you
don't want anymore? {01 00 00 05 00}If you
do, give 'em to me!
{07 0e 00}All the cool kids call used 
clothes "mintage," right?
Oh, wait{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}. I meant vintage!
{07 00 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}{07 16 00}Anyway, I heard{07 00 00}
that hipsters are all about
vintage stuff.
messages.et:
{07 00 00}Ehk peaksin midagi ette
võtma oma kontrollimatu
riiete ostmise harjumusega.
{07 16 00}Sest{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.ma olen puruvaene,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!

{07 04 00}Kas sul on riideid, mida

{07 0e 00}Lahedad lapsed kutsuvad

Ah{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}. Mõtlesin vintage!
{07 00 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}{07 16 00}Igatahes kuulsin,{07 00 00}
et hipsterid on täiega
